description: This file defines an abstract class 'JarIndexVerifier' for verifying the signature and attributes of a JAR file, specifically for F-Droid's signing format, including methods for extracting certificates and verifying signatures, as well as a custom exception class 'SigningException'.

classes.name: JarIndexVerifier
classes.description: Abstract class for verifying JAR file signatures and attributes, tailored for F-Droid's signing format.

classes.name: SigningException
classes.description: Custom exception class for signature verification errors.

methods.name: getStreamAndVerify
methods.description: Opens the JAR file, verifies it, and retrieves a stream of the specified JSON file along with its signing certificate.

methods.name: getX509Certificate
methods.description: Extracts the X509Certificate from a signed JAR entry.

methods.name: verifyAndGetSigningCertificate
methods.description: Verifies the signing certificate's fingerprint or full certificate against expected values.
